note: postSkillResolution calls BattleActionEngine.planPostSkillResolution with the effectId, effectMode and chanceOrParam the skill table actually holds for that id, so heal, buffId and buffOwner are the decision the runtime makes before anything lands on a unit; the three booleans are the same ones VqsvBattleRuntime passes in. presentation calls BattleStatusPresentationProjector.project on a freshly seeded unit, so held is what survived the apply and slots is the visible strip in HUD order with the atlas cell and badge duration already resolved; both are truncated at the six-slot source limit. A row whose slots is empty means the status is invisible by Java's own rules, not that the port skipped it. copy walks BattleUnit.copySourceBuffsFrom and dumps both strips afterwards, so the number of buffs that move and the source they leave behind are graded together. effectNames is the row name the runtime prints as the post-effect text. durationCells is VqsvBattleRenderer.durationCell read by reflection, and it is the badge cell, not the number shown.
